title: FY047B: population aged 15 years and over, by county and city, sex, principal economic status and age group
used_for: I-069's fix. The age profile WITHIN each principal economic status for Cork City and Cork County, used to condition the economic-status draw on age in population/synthesise.py. SAPS publishes economic status by sex and small area and NEVER by age, so this is the only way the joint can be fitted at all. Exposure is `tuning` because the population is built from it, so it can never validate the population (7.1, I-058) - F1054 does that, held out.
